summary: Iter 18: Verified booking all-in promo pricing, AR breakdown/cost invoices, contract breakdown, force delete deal, receipt delete, ReserveDialog, DealsListTab delete button, SPK from RAB dialog (unit + add-on badge). 6/6 backend pytests pass; all frontend flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/finance/ar/{deal_id} returns receipts as a SIBLING to `data` (top-level), not nested inside data — non-obvious API shape; documented for future testing agents.
DELETE /api/finance/ar/receipts/{rid} without trailing slash returns 307 redirect when reason missing (FastAPI trailing-slash behavior); after redirect it validates and returns 400. Cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway booked deals created during backend tests (units A-05 & B-03/others from available pool) — force-deleted in teardown; unit statuses restored to available. No permanent seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response: token is at top-level `access_token` (not inside data). AR detail endpoint returns receipts and cost_invoices at top-level next to data. DealsListTab lives at /deals under the 'Deal' tab (default tab is 'Unit'). ReserveDialog opens from /leads/<id> → tab Unit → 'Buat Reservasi'. SPK dialog uses data-testid 'spk-rab-dialog' with 'spk-rab-project', 'spk-rab-unit', 'spk-rab-unit-check', 'spk-unit-addons' badges. Available units seed count fluctuates as tests create/delete deals.

backend_full_flow.GET /api/finance/ar/{id}: breakdown.cost_discount=27jt, buyer_total = net_price + cost_total; cost_invoices[0] = INB with BPHTB(disc 27jt) + NOTARY_FEE
backend_full_flow.GET /api/finance/ar list: row includes cost_total, cost_outstanding, buyer_total, cost_invoice_numbers
backend_full_flow.contract breakdown rows: UNIT_PRICE, ADDON_SPEC 18.5jt, PROMO_DISCOUNT (0), BOOKING_FEE, BPHTB (net), NOTARY_FEE, COST_DISCOUNT 27jt; total_bill = nett_price + costs_total

backend_force_delete.GET /deals/{id}/delete-check: can_force=true; blockers include ar_invoices, receipts, booking_fee_invoices, cost_invoices, contracts

frontend_finance.receipt delete: ar-receipt-delete-btn present (2), dialog + reason textarea + confirm button; short reason keeps confirm disabled, ≥10 chars enables

frontend_deal_delete.dialog: shows 10 blocker rows (ar_invoices, receipts, booking_fee_invoices, customer_deposits, contract_liabilities, tax_records, commissions, cost_invoices, contracts, journal_entries)
frontend_deal_delete.reason validation: confirm disabled for short reason, enabled for ≥10 chars

frontend_reserve_dialog.sections: Unit Tersedia, Skema pembayaran, Add-on, BIAYA TRANSAKSI — SKEMA ALL-IN, Skema diskon, Promo, Kode kupon, Simulasi KPR, Booking fee, 'Hitung rincian harga' button

rca of the issue: No issues found. All backend fixes (payment_breakdown for all-in EXCLUDE scheme, AR breakdown with buyer_total/cost_components, INB cost invoices per booking, force delete cascade, receipt delete) and frontend components (ArPanel, ArDetailSheet, DealsListTab with DeleteEntityButton force delete, SpkFromRabDialog) work as specified.
